title: Truffle & Aged Cheese Board
h1: Truffle & Aged Cheese Board for Two
seo_title: Truffle Cheese Board for Two: Aged Parmigiano & Nebbiolo
description: A truffle cheese board for two: 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano, Sottocenere-style truffle cheese, prosciutto di Parma, truffle salami, aged balsamic and truffle honey.
hook: Earthy, aged and worth every penny: a small board that spends its budget on flavor, not volume.
why: Truffle and aged cheese share the same savory, earthy depth, so they make each other taste bigger. Crunchy 24-month Parmigiano, a truffle cheese like Sottocenere, truffle salami and prosciutto di Parma are all from the same part of the flavor map.

A few drops of aged balsamic on the Parmigiano and truffle honey on the truffle cheese add sweetness without hiding anything. Fresh figs or pear and Marcona almonds keep it from feeling heavy, and Nebbiolo is the classic wine for truffles.

timeline.what: Take out the meats; open the Nebbiolo to breathe.
Drizzle the balsamic and truffle honey.

faq.a: Aged, nutty cheeses: Parmigiano-Reggiano, aged pecorino and truffle-studded cheeses like Sottocenere. Creamy brie with truffle honey is another favorite.

faq.q: What wine goes with truffle cheese?
faq.a: Nebbiolo (Barolo or Langhe Nebbiolo) is the traditional match. Its earthy, rose-like aroma suits truffle.
Many are flavored with truffle aroma rather than truffle pieces. Check the label; both taste good, but the ones with real truffle cost more.
